info.title: Itential Platform
info.description: Itential Platform's own REST API in full: Automation Studio (workflows, Workflow Builder, Workflow Engine, JSON Forms, Templates), Method of Procedures command templates, Integration Models and integration instances, platform/adapter/service health and worker control, Configuration Manager (Golden Config, compliance, device groups/templates/backups/configuration, config parsers), Lifecycle Manager (resource models/instances/actions/groups), Inventory Manager (inventories/nodes/actions/tags), Operations Manager (jobs, tasks, triggers -- including schedule triggers -- events, and automations), and FlowAI (agent projects/agents, sessions, work items, model registry). Lets one Itential Platform (or Itential Gateway) automate the configuration and operation of another Itential Platform instance, or itself.
info.x-itential-curated: Hand-authored from Itential's own published per-operation API reference (docs.itential.com/itential-platform/6/6/api-reference) and downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (docs.itential.com/openapi/api-reference-3.yaml). This is one Integration Model covering Itential Platform's full REST API surface -- Itential ships one platform with one API, so there is one spec and one integration instance here, matching that. The 7 Studio Projects in this product each curate a different day-to-day activity (Studio: building/running workflows; Admin: integrations and platform health; Configuration Manager; Lifecycle Manager; Inventory Manager; Operations Manager: running/scheduling/triggering automations; FlowAI) from this shared model -- see each project's README section for what it covers and what it deliberately leaves out.

type.description: required, discriminates which of the fields below apply

formData.description: required for type=manual; optional for type=schedule

firstRunAt.description: required for type=schedule -- epoch milliseconds for the first/only run. This is the entire scheduling mechanism; Itential has no separate cron field.

repeat.description: Recurrence rule. Itential has no cron expression -- recurrence is this discriminated interval tree instead. Omit/null for a one-time (non-recurring) run.

type.description: Variant 0/2: 'repeating' runs forever on the interval; 'terminating' + count stops after N runs; a date-range variant (start/end) also exists -- use start/end instead of duration/count for that variant

count.description: required for the count-bounded ('terminating') variant instead of an end date

start.description: required for the date-range variant, instead of duration

components.description: nested child interval definitions for sub-schedules within a parent interval; usually []

apiKeyAuth.name: token
apiKeyAuth.description: Token obtained from POST /login using a username/password body. Itential Platform automates the retrieval and injects it as the 'token' query parameter on every request. The response body is the bare token string itself (no JSON envelope), so no responsePointer is set.
